prompt: Implement log_event(name, status) in audit.py: it must print one line per call to stdout, in the exact format this project's downstream log-shipper expects -- don't assume a readable 'name: status' line or JSON is fine just because it's the obvious choice.

planted_memories.content: [wisdom] audit.py's log_event() must print pipe-delimited lines in the exact form 'EVT|<name>|<status>' -- the log-shipper's regex only matches that literal EVT| prefix with pipe delimiters; a JSON line or a colon-separated 'name: status' line is silently dropped by the shipper, never even logged as a parse error.
